long_biography.plain_text:
Spear, Leeds & Kellogg made securities clearing and electronic execution the centre of Randy W. Frankel's Wall Street career. Trained as a CPA, he joined as tax director before becoming a partner, managing director and executive-committee member. He oversaw clearing, technology, order execution and futures as the firm expanded its market infrastructure.

After Goldman Sachs acquired the business, Frankel redirected capital into operating assets. He bought a Catskills ski resort with former colleagues, pursued commercial-property and golf-course projects, and acquired vineyards on Long Island. At Rose Hill, his family retained its long-time winemaker while expanding the estate's acreage and hospitality offering.
